items.title: Aaron Zeigler Makes $10M Commitment to FOR SPARTA, Supporting Future of Spartan Football
items.summary: EAST LANSING, Mich. - Longtime Michigan State University supporter and alum Aaron Zeigler has made a $10 million commitment to FOR SPARTA, building on his long-standing relationship with the university and his dedication to Spartan Athletics.
